currentContext.expansion: The bundle discloses no new plant, line or capacity-addition project for FY 2026 - Pfizer Limited operates a single manufacturing site (Goa) with 1 plant and 3 offices nationally and no international locations. The only physical investment described is at the Goa site: an onsite 1,500 kWp solar installation, commissioned in 2019, which generated approximately 2,580 MWh of renewable electricity in FY 2025-26, meeting roughly 49% of the site's total energy consumption, alongside continuing investment in energy-efficient production equipment and utility systems, wastewater treatment and reuse for gardening, and condensate recovery. The site maintained Zero Waste to Landfill status with 75.49% of total waste recycled, and carbon footprint per million tablets fell from 0.72 tCO2 in FY 2024-25 to 0.57 tCO2 in FY 2025-26. Expansion of reach in FY 2026 was commercial rather than capital - the exclusive marketing and distribution partnership with Cipla Limited and technology-enabled distribution with GoApptiv extend access into Tier 2 cities and non-metro markets. The Capital Commitments named disclosure supplied with this bundle carries no readable figure or unit, so no rupee capex quantum is usable.
